prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait background illustration for a mobile animal memory matching game. Primary request: a calm friendly woodland clearing that complements cute rounded 3D clay animal portraits. Portrait 9:16 composition. Soft mint and pale sage green center with a subtle warm cream glow, almost blank and low contrast across the central 75 percent of the canvas so a 4 by 4 grid of cards and score can be placed over it. Frame only the far left and right edges and bottom corners with rounded stylized leaves, small ferns, a few tiny pastel flowers and smooth stones. Softly blurred distant tree shapes near the upper outer corners. Matte clay / soft 3D storybook aesthetic, gentle diffuse daylight, no harsh shadows. Warm welcoming restrained pastel palette. No animals or characters, no cards, no lettering, no UI elements, no buttons, no logos, no watermark. Background must fill the whole image, opaque. Prioritize visual quiet and readability behind game controls.
